en.title: Prison Break
en.description: Find the longest consecutive run of removed horizontal bars and of removed vertical bars separately; the side length of the largest hole is the length of the consecutive run plus 1.
en.input: The first line contains n, m, |h|, |v|; the second line gives the indices of the removed horizontal bars, and the third line gives the indices of the removed vertical bars. 1≤n,m≤100000; the arrays are non-empty and the indices lie within 1..n/m respectively; each bar appears at most once.
en.output: Output the area of the largest hole (64-bit integer).
en.explanation: Derive a linear-scan/dynamic-programming solution directly from the problem rules; the examples have been checked case by case against an independently built oracle.
hints: First turn the operations or constraints in the statement into a concrete array/state transition, then analyze the edge cases.
